# KeronisEngine

> Open-source C++20 trading engine capable of ingesting full-exchange crypto feeds (10,000+ msg/s) with continuous streaming feature state machines and in-process ONNX Runtime inference on a single ~$100 dedicated server. Apache-2.0 licensed.

## Full Documentation (Single-Fetch Markdown)

- [Complete Documentation Bundle](https://engine.keronis.ai/llms-full.txt): All documentation pages concatenated in clean Markdown for single-request ingestion.

## Documentation Pages

- [Home](https://engine.keronis.ai/): Overview, performance highlights, and supported venues.
- [Quickstart](https://engine.keronis.ai/quickstart/): Docker and native Linux build instructions, unit tests, and runnable SMA crossover backtest.
- [Architecture](https://engine.keronis.ai/architecture/): `Core::Engine`, `TradeTicker`, `RingBufferBook`, `StrategyStateMachine`, `BacktestState`, `PaperExchange`, and `live_infra`.
- [Comparison](https://engine.keronis.ai/comparison/): Honest comparison with NautilusTrader and HFTBacktest.
- [Writing a Strategy](https://engine.keronis.ai/strategies/): `KERONIS_REGISTER_STRATEGY`, `-DKERONIS_STRATEGY_DIRS`, `strategy_helpers.h`, and quote-pull gates.
- [State Machines & ONNX](https://engine.keronis.ai/state-machines/): `KERONIS_REGISTER_STATE_MACHINE`, `historical_feature_gen`, and ONNX Runtime inference.
- [Live & Paper Trading](https://engine.keronis.ai/live-and-paper/): Docker Compose stack (Postgres + NATS), `schema.sql`, `PaperExchange`, `QuoteHolds`, and direct venue signing.
- [Control Server API](https://engine.keronis.ai/control-server/): Embedded HTTP introspection and gated control endpoints (`/control/*`).
- [Configuration & Env Vars](https://engine.keronis.ai/configuration/): Complete environment variable and backtest `config.json` reference.
